Your whole business, in one app.

Billing, stock, udhaar, GST and reports in Workspace. Buying from wholesalers in Business Mart. One login, one subscription, one data.

BizYour is a business management app by DILIGENCE, a team based in Delhi, India. It is made for Indian businesses that sell goods — kirana and general stores, mobile and electronics shops, garments, hardware, electrical, cosmetics, footwear, gift and stationery shops, and the wholesalers and distributors who supply them. The app works in English, Hindi and Hinglish.

Workspace: everything the counter needs

  • Billing — fast bills at the counter, shared with the customer on WhatsApp as a PDF. No printer needed.
  • Stock — inventory with low-stock alerts, so nothing runs out silently.
  • Udhaar — customer credit tracked clearly, with a shareable hisab link for each customer.
  • Purchases — supplier purchases and payments recorded against stock.
  • Estimates and returns — quotations and sale/purchase returns handled in the same place.
  • GST and reports — GST figures for filing (including GSTR-1 data) and a monthly business report card.
  • Your data stays yours — backup, export and account deletion are built in. BizYour does not sell business data and runs no ad trackers.

Business Mart: the businesses' own wholesale bazaar

Business Mart is a B2B marketplace inside the same BizYour app. A retailer sends an inquiry to wholesalers, receives quotes, and places an order. When the buyer marks the order received, it automatically becomes a purchase and the stock is updated — no separate entry. Business Mart is free to use. The Workspace comes with a 30-day free trial that starts when the workspace is set up; there is no card and no automatic charge, and if the trial ends without payment the data stays visible in read-only form.

Questions

How much does it cost?
Business Mart is free. Workspace is completely free for the first 30 days, with no card needed. After the trial you choose a plan; all your data and work stay exactly as they are.
Is Business Mart really free?
Yes. Business Mart is free for every business, with no trial and no end date. Only Workspace has a 30-day trial and then a paid plan.
What happens after the Workspace trial?
You choose a monthly or yearly plan. If you wait, Workspace turns read-only: you can still see and export everything, nothing is deleted. Business Mart keeps working.
Is internet necessary?
No. Billing also works offline. Bills keep getting made, and the data syncs when the internet comes back.
Does it handle GST?
Yes. GST bills, a full GST report and a ready GSTR-1 file for your CA, all from the same data. Businesses without GST can turn it off.
Can my staff use it?
Yes. Each staff member gets their own login with role limits, like billing and stock only. Profit and reports stay with the owner.
Do I need a computer?
No. It runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer. Open bizyour.in and log in.
Is my data safe?
Your data is yours. Every business sees only its own data, and you can back up or export it whenever you want. No lock-in.
Which languages does it work in?
English, Hindi and Hinglish. Switch any time, whichever feels easy.
